story_title: As an Event Organiser, I want to view the current status of my event request so that I know how far it has progressed

acceptance_criteria.text: The Event Organiser can view the current status of their event.
The status reflects the latest action performed on the event.
The system displays appropriate statuses such as Submitted, Under Review, Approved, Planning, Confirmed, Completed, Rejected, Postponed, Withdrawn or Cancelled.
The Event Organiser cannot manually change the event status.

test_cases.title: My Events shows each of the organiser's events with its current status badge
test_cases.preconditions:
Test data freshly loaded: run `npm run fixtures:spm27` from the project folder just before this case.
Logged in as Hakim Zulkifli (hakim.zulkifli@bayuenergypa.com / password123), Event Organiser, Bayu Energy Partners.
steps: Click 'My Events' in the sidebar
Find each SPM27 event in the list and read its Status column
test_cases.test_data: SPM27 Bayu Safety Briefing: Submitted | SPM27 Bayu Grid Workshop: Under review | SPM27 Bayu Supplier Day: Approved | SPM27 Bayu Leadership Retreat: Planning | SPM27 Bayu Annual Conference: Confirmed | SPM27 Bayu Graduate Induction: Completed | SPM27 Bayu Overnight Site Visit: Rejected | SPM27 Bayu Community Fair: Postponed | SPM27 Bayu Partner Lunch: Withdrawn | SPM27 Bayu Product Showcase: Cancelled
test_cases.expected_result:
Each SPM27 event shows a coloured status badge with exactly the label listed in Test data.
No status is shown as a raw value such as 'under_review'.
Only Bayu Energy Partners events are listed; no other company's events appear.

test_cases.title: Event page status changes after another role acts on the event
test_cases.preconditions:
Test data freshly loaded: run `npm run fixtures:spm27` from the project folder just before this case.
'SPM27 Bayu Investor Day' is Submitted with no coordinator.
Accounts: Hakim Zulkifli (hakim.zulkifli@bayuenergypa.com / password123), Event Organiser; Grace Lim (grace.lim@connectsphere.com / password123), Event Operations Manager.
steps: Log in as Hakim Zulkifli and open 'SPM27 Bayu Investor Day' from 'My Events'
Read the badge under the title and the 'Status' row in the 'Details' card
Log out and log in as Grace Lim
Click 'Assignments' in the sidebar
On the 'SPM27 Bayu Investor Day' row, choose 'Hui Shan Neo' in 'Assign to' and click 'Assign'
Log out and log in as Hakim Zulkifli
Click 'My Events' and open 'SPM27 Bayu Investor Day'
test_cases.test_data: Event: SPM27 Bayu Investor Day | Coordinator: Hui Shan Neo
test_cases.expected_result:
Before the assignment, the header badge and the Details 'Status' row both read 'Submitted'.
After the assignment, both read 'Under review'.

test_cases.title: Choosing 'Keep request' in the withdraw dialog leaves the status unchanged
test_cases.preconditions:
Test data freshly loaded: run `npm run fixtures:spm27` from the project folder just before this case.
'SPM27 Bayu Safety Briefing' is Submitted.
Logged in as Hakim Zulkifli (hakim.zulkifli@bayuenergypa.com / password123).
Withdrawal is a team decision (Sammi Chua, 2026-10-01): the organiser may withdraw their own request only while it is Submitted or Under review, and Withdrawn is final.
steps: Click 'My Events' and open 'SPM27 Bayu Safety Briefing'
Click 'Withdraw request'
In the dialog 'Withdraw this request?', click 'Keep request'
Reload the page
test_cases.expected_result:
The dialog closes.
After reloading, the badge still reads 'Submitted' and the 'Withdraw request' button is still shown.

test_cases.title: Organiser withdraws a Submitted or Under review request
test_cases.preconditions:
Test data freshly loaded: run `npm run fixtures:spm27` from the project folder (TC03 does not change the data, so it can run straight after TC03).
'SPM27 Bayu Safety Briefing' is Submitted; 'SPM27 Bayu Grid Workshop' is Under review (coordinator Hui Shan Neo).
Logged in as Hakim Zulkifli (hakim.zulkifli@bayuenergypa.com / password123).
Team decision: see TC03.
steps: Click 'My Events' and open 'SPM27 Bayu Safety Briefing'
Click 'Withdraw request'
In the dialog 'Withdraw this request?', click 'Withdraw request'
Repeat steps 1-3 for 'SPM27 Bayu Grid Workshop'
test_cases.test_data: Submitted: SPM27 Bayu Safety Briefing | Under review: SPM27 Bayu Grid Workshop
test_cases.expected_result: For each event, the success message 'Your request has been withdrawn.' is shown and the status badge changes to 'Withdrawn'.

test_cases.title: Organiser has no way to change the status of an event from Approved onwards
test_cases.preconditions:
Test data loaded: run `npm run fixtures:spm27` from the project folder if it has not been run for this test pass.
Logged in as Hakim Zulkifli (hakim.zulkifli@bayuenergypa.com / password123).
steps: Click 'My Events' and open 'SPM27 Bayu Supplier Day'
Look for 'Withdraw request' or any button, dropdown or field that changes the status
Repeat for every other event in Test data
test_cases.test_data: Approved (first status after the withdraw window closes): SPM27 Bayu Supplier Day | Planning: SPM27 Bayu Leadership Retreat | Confirmed: SPM27 Bayu Annual Conference | Postponed: SPM27 Bayu Community Fair | Completed: SPM27 Bayu Graduate Induction | Rejected: SPM27 Bayu Overnight Site Visit | Cancelled: SPM27 Bayu Product Showcase | Withdrawn: SPM27 Bayu Partner Lunch
test_cases.expected_result:
On every event the status is shown only as the badge and the read-only Details 'Status' row.
No 'Withdraw request' button is shown, and there is no button, dropdown or field that changes the status.

test_cases.title: A request already withdrawn in another tab cannot be withdrawn again
test_cases.preconditions:
Test data freshly loaded: run `npm run fixtures:spm27` from the project folder just before this case (TC06 does not change the data, so it can run straight after TC06).
'SPM27 Bayu Town Hall' is Submitted.
Logged in as Hakim Zulkifli (hakim.zulkifli@bayuenergypa.com / password123).
Team decision: see TC03.
steps: Open 'SPM27 Bayu Town Hall' from 'My Events' in browser tab A
Open the same event in a second browser tab B
In tab A, click 'Withdraw request' and confirm with 'Withdraw request'
In tab B (still showing 'Submitted'), click 'Withdraw request' and confirm with 'Withdraw request'
test_cases.expected_result: Tab B shows the error 'This event is Withdrawn and can't be moved to Withdrawn.' and no success message.

test_cases.preconditions:
Test data loaded: run `npm run fixtures:spm27` from the project folder if it has not been run for this test pass.
'SPM27 Bayu Partner Lunch' was withdrawn while Submitted (no coordinator); 'SPM27 Bayu Wind Farm Tour' was withdrawn while Under review (coordinator Hui Shan Neo).
steps: Log in as Grace Lim (grace.lim@connectsphere.com / password123)
Click 'Assignments' in the sidebar and look for 'SPM27 Bayu Partner Lunch' in 'Awaiting assignment'
Click 'All Events' and open 'SPM27 Bayu Partner Lunch'
Log out and log in as Hui Shan Neo (huishan.neo@connectsphere.com / password123)
Click 'All Events' and open 'SPM27 Bayu Wind Farm Tour'
Open the 'Equipment' tab
test_cases.test_data: Withdrawn from Submitted: SPM27 Bayu Partner Lunch | Withdrawn from Under review: SPM27 Bayu Wind Farm Tour
test_cases.expected_result:
'SPM27 Bayu Partner Lunch' is not in the 'Awaiting assignment' list, and its event page has no 'Assign a coordinator' card.
